description: K1 PROOF ONLY, NEVER DELIVER (o deliver recusa esta pasta e esta marca antes de registrar a tarefa). K1 (Manage Dependencies headless), prova OFFLINE: acrescenta a entidade User do (System) e AgentOps_Core_CS.GetAgentRunTrace (com o fechamento RunTraceDTO/TraceItemDTO) a uma copia do HMISJHA_CS publicado (v5578) so por assinaturas .avsig, sem o OML dos produtores no job, e prova o uso numa action PRIVADA de prova, sem inputs, que nunca e entregue (le so o registro do proprio usuario da sessao; nao chama Login e nao recebe UserId). O unico consumidor da action e um timer SEM agendamento (uma server action nao publica sem consumidor recebe UnusedUserAction e a regra N4 do gate conta todo aviso). As assinaturas desta prova sao evidencia offline (anvil signature-fixture, environment offline.invalid) e o deliver as recusa; ao vivo use o .avsig de `anvil signature`. Registro: docs/proofs/2026-09-26-o11-manage-dependencies.md.

actions.name: ProbeK1RunTraceAndUser
actions.description: K1 PROBE ONLY, NEVER DELIVER: private offline proof that the imported dependencies are usable. Counts the trace items AgentOps_Core_CS GetAgentRunTrace returns for no run (through its RunTraceDTO/TraceItemDTO closure) and reads the signed-in user's own (System) User record by GetUserId(); it takes no input and signs nobody in. GetAgentRunTrace records a DataAccessEvent for an oversight reader: this probe writes nothing only because its sole caller is the unscheduled timer, which runs without a session, so RequireOversightReaderRole raises before RecordOversightDataAccess.

outputs.name: TraceItems
outputs.description: Number of trace items returned by GetAgentRunTrace.

outputs.name: IsSessionUserActive
outputs.description: Whether the signed-in user's own (System) User record is active; proves the User entity reference.
